column2: To add a pass, choose {button}, give it a name and pick the format of the code on your ticket or card. Then type the text or number stored in the code: for a barcode, it's usually printed under the bars. You can also add short notes, such as a seat or a gate, shown on the ticket.
To show a pass, open it from the list and hold the screen up to the scanner. In a dim place, the light button turns the front light up to full brightness until you leave the pass.
To show a pass, open it from the list and hold the screen up to the scanner.
Barcodes run down the ticket so they can be as large as possible. If a scanner can't read one, turn the device sideways.
Press and hold a pass in the list to edit it, move it, show it on the lock screen or delete it. Swipe or use the page keys to turn the pages of the list.
Hold OK on a pass in the list to edit it, move it, show it on the lock screen or delete it. Move past the first or last pass of a page to turn the page.
